newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close higher on PTCL buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close higher on PTCL buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Monday on buying of Pakistan Telecommunication Co Ltd after it disclosed a new restructuring plan, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index closed 17.23 points, or 1.24 percent, higher at 1,409.16 amid 140 losers and 103 gainers. Volume rose to 28 million shares from Sunday's 23 million.
Another factor behind the rise was the postponement of the settlement day to Tuesday from Monday, providing more time for jobbers to play the market, dealer Asif Janmohammad said.
Broker Faisal Abbas said the rise was temporary and the index would fall because the market had been over-bought.
He cited the absence of foreign selling as another reason for Monday's bullish sentiment. Local institutions took advantage to off-load their excess stocks.
PTCL rose 0.30 rupee to 27 on 3.0 million shares. HUBCO added 0.30 to 33.25, Nishat Mills 2.25 to 15.75, ICI 0.10 to 19.20 and Fauji Fertilizer 0.25 to 67.75.
